notes.title: Update - Version 1.0.4
notes.content:
The Sea Between has officially been released just over a month now and I'd like to thank everybody who has taken a chance and purchased this game. It really means a lot to me that people are giving this game a chance and really enjoying it. 

I've been trying my best to keep up with any issues that people have as well to make sure that everybody has the best possible experience. Here are the list of changes since the last version.

Patch Notes:
-Added a small number of save prompts to allow the player more opportunity to save during longer sections of the game.
-Added Save Point to Vawn.
-Updated Queen Roxana’s throne.
-Updated the trees in Shaylin and at Majoha Temple.
-Updated a few doodads around Rawls Forest and Majoha Temple.
-Added Version number of the game to the main title screen.

For a list of the previous patch notes for previous versions, please refer to the official website:
www.theseabetweengame.com
